blocks.text: Wake Up with Soft, Natural-Looking Brows, Eyes, Lips, and Scalp Definition
At Pomi B. Brow Studio, I create permanent makeup that looks clean, balanced, and natural on your face. My goal is to help you save time while keeping your results soft enough for everyday life.
Permanent makeup is personal. Your brows, eyes, lips, and hairline should still feel like you. I focus on soft shaping, careful color choices, and results that fit your features.
If you fill in your brows every morning, permanent brows may help you feel more ready when you wake up. I offer microblading, ombre powder brows, and microblading with shading.
Ombre powder brows for soft shading
Permanent makeup is not only for brows. I also offer eyeliner, lash enhancement, lip tint, and scalp micropigmentation for clients who want subtle definition with less daily effort.
Lash enhancement for soft eye definition

Pomi B. Brow Studio is located at 2801 El Camino Real, Ste 13 in Tustin, CA, close to Irvine and central Orange County. Services include microblading, ombre powder brows, microblading with shading, permanent eyeliner, lash enhancement, lip tint, scalp micropigmentation, touch-ups, and tattoo removal.
